description: Merge block faces. Listed by 'block face ?' on 3DEC 9.8 and 7.00; the manual has no page for it.

notes: It takes no range: 'block face merge range ...' stops with 'Unused extra parameter'.
The face count did not change on a cut, zoned brick (64 before and after).
